name: Математический спринт
tagline: Шестьдесят секунд устного счёта. Сколько решите верно?
description: Играйте в «Математический спринт» бесплатно: минута устного счёта на лёгком, среднем или сложном уровне. Ставьте рекорды или играйте онлайн.
about: Math Sprint is sixty seconds of mental arithmetic. A problem appears, you type the answer, and the next one comes straight away. Every right answer is a point; a wrong one scores nothing and shows you the right answer, so you can keep going without losing your rhythm.

There are three levels. Easy is adding and taking away up to twenty, good for warming up or for younger players. Medium goes up to a hundred and adds the times tables to twelve. Hard mixes two-digit multiplication, exact division and three-digit sums. Each level has its own best score and leaderboard.
No answer is ever negative or a fraction, so you only ever type a whole number. Race friends online on the same level and you'll all get the very same problems at the same moment.
howToPlay: Choose a level. After a 3, 2, 1 countdown the first problem appears and the minute starts.
Type the answer and press OK (or Enter).
The next problem shows at once, with a note saying whether the last one was right.
A right answer is a point. A wrong one scores nothing; just carry on.
When the minute is up you see your right and wrong answers.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap the number keys, then OK.
Mouse: click the number keys, then OK.
Keyboard: type the digits, Backspace to correct, Enter to answer.
Pause or start again from the bar above the game. Pausing starts the minute over.
tips: Break big sums into parts: 47 + 38 is 47 + 30 + 8.
For times tables, know the squares (7 × 7, 8 × 8) and work from them.
Division is multiplication backwards: 96 ÷ 8 asks what times 8 makes 96.
Don't stop after a wrong answer: there's no penalty, only a lost point.
On a computer, typing with the number keys is much faster than clicking.

faq.question: Is Math Sprint free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: What is a good score?
faq.answer: On easy, 30 or more in a minute is quick. On medium, 25; on hard, 15 is a strong score.

faq.question: Are there negative numbers or fractions?
faq.answer: No. Every answer is a whole number of zero or more, and divisions always come out exactly.

faq.question: Is there a penalty for a wrong answer?
faq.answer: No penalty: a wrong answer just doesn't score, and you see the right answer under the next problem.

faq.question: How do races work?
faq.answer: Everyone in the room plays the same level and gets the same problems. The most right answers in the minute wins.
